remarks: Luxury living in Westridge, Valencia's premier golf community. Welcome to 26163 Shadow Rock Lane, a showcase home on a quiet cul-de-sac lot, offering five bedrooms, five bathrooms, and a bonus room across 3,960 square feet of light-filled living. Behind a custom quartz entry, engineered wood flooring runs throughout both levels, with soaring ceilings and elegant formal living and dining areas. The spacious great room, warmed by a gas fireplace, opens to a center-island kitchen with granite countertops and backsplash, white cabinetry, and a large pantry, made for gathering.
